title: VUA packages-ops command v0.3
description: Packages write face, third frozen slice A3 = register_local_package (proposal 026 face order; the v0.1 A1 removal row and the v0.2 A2 install/upgrade row stay frozen and served untouched — v0.3 is a separate row directory per the packages-catalog v0.2 increment precedent). Exactly five methods on the packages.* family: the A1 pair (packages.previewRemove / packages.applyRemove, v0.1 shapes verbatim), the A2 pair (packages.previewInstall / packages.applyInstall, v0.2 shapes verbatim), plus the A3 single method packages.registerLocalPackage mapped one-to-one onto the VpmBackend port method register_local_package. THE A3 FACE DELIBERATELY BREAKS THE preview/apply PAIR SHAPE — the only face in the family without a preview arm: the port has NO preview method for registration (the implementation documents the fact: 'Registration is deliberately separate from preview/apply: the normal digest-bound install path still owns every project mutation'), registration is an IDEMPOTENT set-add into the backend's isolated environment (the library's AlreadyAdded result answers success, never an error), it is non-destructive (it adds one user-package row; it removes and rewrites nothing), and there is no pre-existing state to drift (no digest, no confirmedDigest, no double-digest guard). The user's explicit submission IS the confirmation (the A5 create-project stance's same direction: a form submission is an explicit confirmation; ADR-0006's destructive warning path does not apply — the face invents no destructive fact). packages.registerLocalPackage is a NINE-STATE TASK-DRIVEN write command (the family-consistent shape: applyRemove/applyInstall/project.setNote all ride the task surface — commandId idempotency, cancellable, events+revision, recovery maps non-terminal residue to inspect_required and never resumes implicitly, honesty rule 3). Params are the closed single key {packageRoot}: the local package root directory (the port's package_root projected verbatim, camelCase); it is a filesystem path fact, non-empty; NO projectPath is taken — registration mutates the backend's ISOLATED environment (never the user's VCC or ALCOM settings, never a project; the port signature takes no project). The port answers Result<(), AppErrorV1> — no payload, so the result face carries the request echo only (see result.schema.json). Gate: the wire routes for this method do not exist yet (wiring is the next core slice); serving is capability-gated on the NEW defaulted accessor VpmBackend::register_capabilities() -> RegisterCapabilities (default declared-none, the 025 catalog_capabilities law; one row packages.registerOps serving the one method, the removeOps/installOps one-row precedent; a backend that overrides nothing keeps the row honestly unavailable; a wired backend without the capability answers the generic capability_missing) and the honest-absence wire arm vua.packages.unavailable stays for unwired engines.

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity), same fact and code vua.project.project_not_found when unregistered.

packageIds.description: The closed explicit list of package ids to remove. No wildcard, no 'all' shorthand.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest from the previewRemove result the user confirmed. The server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (vua.packages.preview_drift, recoverable — re-preview, never implicit resumption).

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity), same fact and code vua.project.project_not_found when unregistered.

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name). No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

version.description: Version-selection semantics frozen with the A2 batch: null = the resolver picks (latest stable); a string = pin exactly that version.

packages.description: The closed explicit request list. A repeated packageId across rows is a word-face violation even when the versions differ (uniqueItems pins exact duplicates; the closed-list rule text pins the per-id uniqueness; the negative vector pins the rule).
The SAME closed explicit request list the preview answered (the audit link: the confirmed digest binds to exactly that preview's canonical item list).

confirmedDigest.description: The digest from the previewInstall result the user confirmed. The server re-computes the preview at apply time and refuses on drift (vua.packages.preview_drift, recoverable — re-preview, never implicit resumption).

packageRoot.description: The local package root directory (the port's package_root, verbatim camelCase projection): the directory containing the package.json of the generated local VPM package to register into the backend's isolated environment. A path fact only — no projectId, no projectPath: registration never touches a project or the user's VCC/ALCOM settings. Registration is idempotent (AlreadyAdded answers success) and carries NO digest: there is no pre-existing state to drift and the user's explicit submission IS the confirmation.
